progression.narrative: The performance opens on G4 and dwells most on G in Chaharmezrab-e Chakavak, Chakavak. The line peaks at G4 (384.6 Hz) at 0:59.8. It closes on Fs4, not the tonic (Eb4 → C4 → Eb4 → D3 → D4 → Fs4).
